cp35:1.1: Mettāpāraminiddeso niṭṭhito. UPEKKHĀPĀRAMITĀ Susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chavaṭṭhiṃ upadhāya' haṃ gomaṇḍalā upāgantvā rūpaṃ dassenti' nappakaṃ. || ||
cp35:2.1: Apare gandhañca mālañca bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ bahuṃ upāyanānyupanenti haṭṭhā saṃviggamānasā. || ||
cp35:3.1: Ye me dukkhaṃ upadahanti ye ca denti sukhaṃ mama sabbesaṃ samako homi dayā kopo na vijjati. || ||
cp35:4.1: Sukhadukkhe tulābhūto yasesu ayasesu ca sabbattha samako homi esā me upekkhāpāramīti. || ||
cp35:8.1: Yudhañjayo Somanasso Ayoghara-Bhisena ca Soṇanando Mūgapakkho kapirājā Saccasa' vhayo, || ||
cp35:9.1: Vaṭṭako maccharājā ca Kaṇhadīpāyano isi Sutasomo puna āsiṃ Sāmo ca Ekarāja' hu, upekkhāpāramī āsi iti vutthaṃ mahesinā. || ||
cp35:10.1: Evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dukkhaṃ sampattī ca bahū vidhā bhavābhave anubhavitvā patto sambodhim-uttamaṃ. || ||
cp35:11.1: Datvā dātabbakaṃ dānaṃ sīlaṃ pūretvā asesato nekkhamme pāramiṃ gantvā patto sambodhim-uttamaṃ || ||
cp35:12.1: Paṇḍite paripucchitvā viriyaṃ katvāna uttamaṃ khantiyā pāramiṃ gantvā patto sambodhim-uttamaṃ || ||
cp35:13.1: Katvā daḷham-adhiṭṭhānaṃ saccavacā' nurakkhiya mettāya pāramiṃ gantvā patto sambodhim-uttamaṃ. || ||
cp35:14.1: Lābhālābhe yasāyase sammānanāvamānane sabbattha samako hutvā patto sambodhim-uttamaṃ. || ||
cp35:15.1: Kosajjaṃ bhayato disvā viriyārambhañca khemato āraddhaviriyā hotha esā buddhānusāsanī. || ||
cp35:16.1: Vivādaṃ bhayato disvā avivādañca khemato samaggā sakhilā hotha esā buddhānusāsanī. || ||
cp35:17.1: Pamādaṃ bhayato disvā appamādañca khenato bhāvetha' ṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ esā buddhānusāsanī. || || Yuddhañjayavaggo
cp35:18.1: tatiyo Itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā attano pubbacariyaṃ sambhāvayamāno Buddhāpadāniyaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ abhāsitthā 'ti.
